plan.title: Single-stage RFP required and optional T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Choose a questionnaire template for the RFP.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Fill the required technical questionnaire content.
Assign the evaluator required for publishing a technical event.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days as None, click Done, and stop when the create screen shows the configured terms

steps.note: Configure the two event clauses and their required/none modes, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Invite one QA vendor to the event.
Publish the configured single-stage RFP.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published RFP technical round as the vendor.
Confirm the vendor can see the terms block.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional/none clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the required payment clause.
Accept the delivery clause as required by the scenario.
Fill the technical questionnaire so the vendor can submit.
Submit the vendor's technical response after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the vendor response was submitted successfully.
